budget_accounting: Next group is budget-safe when global_budget >= parallel_group_estimated_wall_secs (= sum of candidate estimated_cost_secs).
recent_text_gradients: Round 1 winner established the benchmark reference using baseline/baseline ↓. Per-dataset HR@10 was imbalanced; prefer follow-ups that preserve weaker datasets, not only aggregate gain.

candidates.budget_accounting: Parallel group cost is sum(estimated_cost_secs) across the selected candidates.
candidates.code_hint:
COMBINATION JUMP: make a substantive, coordinated change in EACH selected direction. 学习目标: Ranking/prediction loss, loss weighting and jointly trained auxiliary objectives. Preserve feature definitions, embeddings, SASRec topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.
特征构造: Construct input features solely from supplied training interactions, such as frequency or recency indicators. No external metadata, independent scorer or score fusion. Keep learned embedding design, SASRec topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.
Only minimal shape/checkpoint/predictor consistency edits outside the chosen directions are allowed; they must not introduce another modeling or training change.
candidates.hypothesis: Memory available in state; agent should write a short arm-specific hypothesis
